title: A fix for how something feels stays open until a device or simulator check is recorded
why: Owner, Nov 1 17:44 CST, forwarding a home repo session's finding: the gap is in every repo, not only home.
note: Shape: a check keeps a feel-fix's step or debt open after CI passes, until a simulator or device check is recorded on it; then it opens a "try it" task for the owner on the waiting page. Today such a fix closes on CI alone while its record still says it waits on the owner. Ready: no open question. Port: yes, every repo.
